```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(glue)
library(htmltools)
library(jsonlite)

# ============================================================
# LOAD DASHBOARD DATA
# ============================================================

summary_data <- read_csv(
  "data/dashboard_summary.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

labour <- read_csv(
  "data/labour_market.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

cpi <- read_csv(
  "data/cpi_capital_cities.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

dwellings <- read_csv(
  "data/dwelling_approvals.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

fuel_monthly <- read_csv(
  "data/fuel_monthly.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

cash_rate_decisions <- if (
  file.exists("data/cash_rate_decisions.csv")
) {
  read_csv(
    "data/cash_rate_decisions.csv",
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
} else {
  tibble()
}

metadata <- fromJSON(
  "data/metadata.json"
)


# ============================================================
# GENERAL HELPERS
# ============================================================

esc <- function(x) {
  as.character(
    htmlEscape(
      as.character(x)
    )
  )
}


first_or <- function(
  x,
  default = ""
) {

  if (
    length(x) == 0 ||
    is.null(x) ||
    is.na(x[[1]])
  ) {
    return(default)
  }

  as.character(x[[1]])
}


html_out <- function(x) {
  cat(
    as.character(x),
    "\n"
  )
}


# ============================================================
# SPARKLINES
# ============================================================

parse_values <- function(x) {

  if (
    length(x) == 0 ||
    is.na(x) ||
    !nzchar(x)
  ) {
    return(numeric())
  }

  y <- as.numeric(
    strsplit(
      x,
      "\\|"
    )[[1]]
  )

  y[is.finite(y)]
}


spark_svg <- function(
  values,
  colour,
  width = 150,
  height = 46
) {

  if (length(values) < 2) {

    return(
      '<span class="no-trend">Daily price only</span>'
    )

  }

  x <- seq(
    4,
    width - 4,
    length.out = length(values)
  )

  rng <- range(
    values,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  if (
    !all(is.finite(rng))
  ) {

    return(
      '<span class="no-trend">No trend available</span>'
    )

  }

  y <- if (diff(rng) == 0) {

    rep(
      height / 2,
      length(values)
    )

  } else {

    4 +
      (max(values) - values) /
      diff(rng) *
      (height - 8)

  }

  points <- paste(
    sprintf(
      "%.1f,%.1f",
      x,
      y
    ),
    collapse = " "
  )

  last_x <- sprintf(
    "%.1f",
    tail(x, 1)
  )

  last_y <- sprintf(
    "%.1f",
    tail(y, 1)
  )

  # Keep SVG on ONE line so Quarto/Pandoc does not
  # accidentally interpret any part as Markdown/code.

  paste0(
    '<svg class="sparkline" ',
    'viewBox="0 0 ', width, ' ', height, '" ',
    'role="img" aria-label="Recent trend">',
    '<polyline ',
    'points="', points, '" ',
    'fill="none" ',
    'stroke="', colour, '" ',
    'stroke-width="3" ',
    'stroke-linecap="round" ',
    'stroke-linejoin="round">',
    '</polyline>',
    '<circle ',
    'cx="', last_x, '" ',
    'cy="', last_y, '" ',
    'r="4" ',
    'fill="white" ',
    'stroke="', colour, '" ',
    'stroke-width="3">',
    '</circle>',
    '</svg>'
  )
}


# ============================================================
# MAIN DASHBOARD ROWS
# ============================================================

status_class <- function(x) {

  paste0(
    "cell-",
    x
  )

}


dashboard_row <- function(
  indicator,
  group,
  latest_display,
  month_display,
  year_display,
  base_display,
  latest_status,
  month_status,
  year_status,
  base_status,
  spark_values,
  spark_colour,
  note,
  fuel_row
) {

  fuel_class <- if (
    isTRUE(
      as.logical(fuel_row)
    )
  ) {
    " fuel-row"
  } else {
    ""
  }


  trend_html <- spark_svg(
    parse_values(
      spark_values
    ),
    spark_colour
  )


  paste0(

    '<div class="summary-row',
    fuel_class,
    '">',

    '<div class="indicator-cell">',

    '<span class="section-kicker">',
    esc(group),
    '</span>',

    '<strong>',
    esc(indicator),
    '</strong>',

    '<small>',
    esc(note),
    '</small>',

    '</div>',


    '<div class="trend-cell">',
    trend_html,
    '</div>',


    '<div class="metric-cell latest-cell ',
    status_class(latest_status),
    '">',
    esc(latest_display),
    '</div>',


    '<div class="metric-cell ',
    status_class(month_status),
    '">',
    esc(month_display),
    '</div>',


    '<div class="metric-cell ',
    status_class(year_status),
    '">',
    esc(year_display),
    '</div>',


    '<div class="metric-cell ',
    status_class(base_status),
    '">',
    esc(base_display),
    '</div>',


    '</div>'

  )

}


rows <- pmap_chr(
  summary_data,
  dashboard_row
)


# ============================================================
# DETAIL TABLE FUNCTION
# ============================================================

make_table <- function(
  data,
  highlight_name = NULL,
  highlight_row = NULL,
  min_width = 980
) {

  if (ncol(data) == 0) {

    return(
      '<p class="section-note">No data available.</p>'
    )

  }


  headers <- paste0(
    "<th>",
    esc(names(data)),
    "</th>",
    collapse = ""
  )


  if (nrow(data) == 0) {

    body <- ""

  } else {

    body <- map_chr(
      seq_len(nrow(data)),
      function(i) {

        cells <- map_chr(
          seq_along(data),
          function(j) {

            classes <- character()


            if (j == 1) {

              classes <- c(
                classes,
                "row-label"
              )

            }


            if (
              !is.null(highlight_name) &&
              names(data)[j] == highlight_name
            ) {

              classes <- c(
                classes,
                "highlight-column"
              )

            }


            if (
              length(highlight_row) > 0 &&
              i %in% highlight_row
            ) {

              classes <- c(
                classes,
                "highlight-row"
              )

            }


            cls <- if (
              length(classes) > 0
            ) {

              paste0(
                ' class="',
                paste(
                  classes,
                  collapse = " "
                ),
                '"'
              )

            } else {

              ""

            }


            paste0(
              "<td",
              cls,
              ">",
              esc(
                data[[j]][i]
              ),
              "</td>"
            )

          }
        )


        paste0(
          "<tr>",
          paste(
            cells,
            collapse = ""
          ),
          "</tr>"
        )

      }
    )

  }


  paste0(

    '<div class="table-wrap">',

    '<table class="data-table" ',
    'style="min-width:',
    min_width,
    'px">',

    '<thead>',
    '<tr>',
    headers,
    '</tr>',
    '</thead>',

    '<tbody>',
    paste(
      body,
      collapse = ""
    ),
    '</tbody>',

    '</table>',

    '</div>'

  )

}


# ============================================================
# FUEL ROWS
# ============================================================

fuel_rows <- summary_data |>
  filter(
    group == "Fuel"
  )


# ============================================================
# RBA CASH-RATE DECISIONS
# ============================================================

cash_year <- format(
  as.Date(
    Sys.time(),
    tz = "Australia/Perth"
  ),
  "%Y"
)


if (nrow(cash_rate_decisions) > 0) {

  cash_tbl <- cash_rate_decisions |>

    mutate(

      effective_date =
        as.Date(effective_date),

      change_ppt =
        as.numeric(change_ppt),

      cash_rate_target =
        as.numeric(cash_rate_target)

    ) |>

    filter(
      format(
        effective_date,
        "%Y"
      ) == cash_year
    ) |>

    arrange(
      desc(effective_date)
    ) |>

    mutate(

      `Effective date` =
        format(
          effective_date,
          "%d %b %Y"
        ),

      Decision =
        decision,

      `Change (ppt)` =
        case_when(

          is.na(change_ppt) ~ "—",

          change_ppt > 0 ~
            paste0(
              "+",
              sprintf(
                "%.2f",
                change_ppt
              )
            ),

          TRUE ~
            sprintf(
              "%.2f",
              change_ppt
            )

        ),

      `Cash rate target` =
        paste0(
          sprintf(
            "%.2f",
            cash_rate_target
          ),
          "%"
        )

    ) |>

    select(
      `Effective date`,
      Decision,
      `Change (ppt)`,
      `Cash rate target`
    )

} else {

  cash_tbl <- tibble()

}
```
